harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored tickets.sql into helpdesk, repaired PostgreSQL ID allocation, preserved the source export, and verified full persistence after rebooting node1. PostgreSQL 8.2.11 is online on the unchanged Ubuntu 7.10 / 2.6.22-14-generic platform.
actions_performed: Created the helpdesk database and restored all three exported tickets.
Advanced tickets_id_seq to the imported maximum ID of 100.
Verified an implicit insert receives ID 101, then rolled back the test row and restored the pristine three-row dataset.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified PostgreSQL, data, sequence behavior, source export, OS, and kernel after recovery.

evidence.requirement: Restore tickets.sql into helpdesk while retaining IDs and text
evidence.summary: helpdesk was created and restored; final rows are 1/Printer queue, 2/Scanner cable, and 100/Office move.

evidence.requirement: Repair allocation so implicit IDs are unique and above the imported maximum
evidence.summary: The stale sequence was observed at 1, repaired to 100, and implicit inserts returned ID 101 both before and after reboot.
tickets.sql remains at /srv/legacy2/postgresql-sequence-repair with unchanged SHA-256 5a9b51de0c539f9ffedd0ca1424be6549bbef62a5414b6545d879d9c1be973c5.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Used Ubuntu 7.10's PostgreSQL 8.2.11 package; Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained unchanged across reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID dedf8cb1-36dd-4d81-b86b-c1a20c2c1865; restart was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID d0f5ef7d-e693-45be-895c-42a49d80b613; PostgreSQL, data, sequence allocation, source export, OS, and kernel all recovered.

attempts.summary: Restored tickets.sql into helpdesk, repaired PostgreSQL ID allocation, preserved the source export, and verified full persistence after rebooting node1. PostgreSQL 8.2.11 is online on the unchanged Ubuntu 7.10 / 2.6.22-14-generic platform.
